sentences.text: It appears that the Applicant No. 2 was accompanying Applicant No. 1 on the personal car of Shri Gupte, the truck owner.

The CDR record shows that several calls were made by Applicant No. 1 - Balaji to the supplier of Gutkha i. e. about 63 calls to Shri Gupte, the truck owner, apart from several calls to the truck drivers.

opennyai_summary.facts:
2. By this Application, the Applicant seeks pre-arrest bail in connection with C. R. No. 60 of 2019 registered with the Kasa Police Station, Palghar, for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 328, 420, 188, 272, 273 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 59 of the Maharashtra Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Although learned counsel for the Applicants submitted that the Applicant No.
1 - Balaji was a personal driver of Shri Om Gupte, owner of the truck, the statement of the Applicant No. 1's father shows that the Applicant No. 1 on completion of MCA was working as an Engineer.
It appears that the Applicant No. 2 was accompanying Applicant No. 1 on the personal car of Shri Gupte, the truck owner.
Hence, the Application stands rejected.
